summary: League, languages, scale, starting with Windows and updates

rows.label: League
rows.note: Where prices are searched. Auto is the trade site's current league; your private leagues show up here once you sign in, in “Account”

rows.label: Game client language
rows.note: The language the game copies items in. Auto tells it from the item's text

rows.label: Interface language
rows.note: The app's own words; items and the trade site stay as they are. Auto follows the game client, or Windows until the game has run

rows.label: Interface scale
rows.note: Size of the text and controls on the price panel and in this window

rows.label: Check for updates automatically
rows.note: Half a minute after launch; a new version shows up in the menu of the icon by the clock
